minutes.headline: Finance Committee heard the cemetery commission on its funds and backed exploring an optional high-deductible health plan.
minutes.summary: The committee met the cemetery commission chair and the finance director about how cemetery funds work, then reviewed a school committee chair's draft for adding a high-deductible health plan option. It also discussed investing idle town funds, the DLS financial policy manual, grant writing services, and compressing the budget process. Only prior minutes were voted; a written approval of an earlier transfer was signed.

public_comment.topic: Read the Constitution preamble and Gettysburg Address; urged the committee to ask questions rather than say no, criticizing its earlier vote against funding extra recreation director hours and saying the account has paid salaries for years.

Lot fee was reviewed about a year ago against other towns.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee took no votes beyond prior minutes; the main business was a briefing from the cemetery commission chair and the finance director on how cemetery funds work.
Members reviewed a draft optional high-deductible health plan and agreed the interim town manager should ask the town's health insurance agent to review it.
The committee discussed idle town funds earning little; the chair will email the treasurer about investment options and asking banks for higher rates.
The chair will ask the interim town manager to explain his budget process at the next meeting, and a written approval of the earlier transfer for the town manager search was signed.
Future agenda items set: interim town manager on budget process, a Chapter 90 DPW presentation, and the treasurer on investments on Sept 12.

why_it_matters: The health plan idea could change what the town and employees pay for health insurance, but it is only at the stage of an agent's review, with no vote yet.
Cemetery funds, idle cash earning little and the budget calendar all bear on what town meeting is asked to appropriate or transfer, and on the tax bill.
watch_next: Sept 12 meeting: the treasurer on investments, the interim town manager on his budget process, and a Chapter 90 DPW presentation.
The health insurance agent's review of the optional high-deductible plan, requested through the interim town manager.
